attempts.text:
{
  "map": true,
  "subject": {
    "columns": ["protein_id"],
    "resolver": "pharos_protein_gene",
    "category": "biolink:Gene",
    "name_column": "name"
  },
  "object": {
    "columns": ["mondoid", "did"],
    "resolver": "curie",
    "category": "biolink:Disease",
    "name_column": "name"
  },
  "predicate": "biolink:gene_associated_with_condition",
  "association_category": "biolink:GeneToDiseaseAssociation",
  "knowledge_level": "knowledge_assertion",
  "agent_type": "manual_agent",
  "primary_knowledge_source": "infores:ctd",
  "qualifiers": {},
  "edge_properties": ["evidence"],
  "keep_if": {
    "column": "evidence",
    "matches": "marker/mechanism",
    "reason": "Rows whose only evidence is 'therapeutic' link a chemical treatment to the disease, not a gene-disease association, so they are kept as gaps and not asserted as gene-condition edges."
  },
  "split_by": null,
  "by_value": {},
  "notes": "Each row links a Pharos protein (resolved to its gene) to a disease. The object uses MONDO ids from mondoid where present (28,778 of 35,187 rows); otherwise the CTD did (DOID or MESH) is used via the curie resolver. The MESH-only disease rows will carry MESH CURIEs. Rows with 'marker/mechanism' evidence (alone or with 'therapeutic') are asserted as direct gene-disease associations, matching the CTD direct-evidence loading note. Rows with only 'therapeutic' evidence are recorded as gaps. The predicate is gene_associated_with_condition, the most specific Biolink gene-disease predicate that fits this source; it is not causal, so no causal qualifiers are added."
}
